# [PR #2071] [FFI] Remove upper version bound on apache-tvm-ffi

source: https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang/pull/2071
state: closed | updated: 2026-09-18T11:56:30Z
labels: 

## 正文

## Summary
- Remove the `<0.1.10` version cap from `apache-tvm-ffi` in `pyproject.toml`, `requirements.txt`, and `requirements-dev.txt`
- The pin was originally added to work around a `derived_object` regression, which has since been resolved in newer releases

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify CI passes with the latest `apache-tvm-ffi` resolved by pip

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Chores**
  * Updated the checked-in TVM dependency to a newer commit.
  * Relaxed apache-tvm-ffi version constraints across project configs to allow newer 0.1.x releases.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Ensure CUDA compilation gets numeric register-usage level values.
  * Make device-function parsing more resilient to host-code variations.
  * Accept direct tensor/global-address identifiers in TMA descriptor handling.

* **Tests**
  * Updated tests to assert kernel/source output via generated kernel source and script representation.

## Walkthrough

Updated the vendored TVM submodule pointer; relaxed `apache-tvm-ffi` upper-version constraint across dependency files; and applied small TileLang CUDA/JIT tweaks (coerce PTXAS register-usage to int, convert TMA global_address to pythonic expression, more resilient host-source lookup, and permissive globalAddress handling).

## Changes

|Cohort / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**TVM Submodule** <br> `3rdparty/tvm`|Bumped the checked-in TVM submodule commit pointer to a new commit (`882a7748449...` → `0e15b274bce8...`).|
|**Dependency files** <br> `pyproject.toml`, `requirements-dev.txt`, `requirements.txt`|Removed the `<0.1.10` upper bound from the `apache-tvm-ffi` spec (`~=0.1.0,>=0.1.2,<0.1.10` → `~=0.1.0,>=0.1.2`).|
|**CUDA compile arg handling** <br> `tilelang/engine/lower.py`, `tilelang/jit/adapter/libgen.py`|Coerce `PassConfigKey.TL_PTXAS_REGISTER_USAGE_LEVEL` to `int` before formatting `--ptxas-options=--register-usage-level=...` for NVCC/PTXAS invocations.|
|**TMA descriptor parsing / handling** <br> `tilelang/jit/adapter/utils.py`, `tilelang/jit/adapter/cutedsl/wrapper.py`|`parse_tma_descriptor_args` now converts `global_address` via `pythonic_expr_func` before storing; `_process_tma_descriptors` no longer requires `info["globalAddress"]` to be a `tvm.tir.Var` and may accept the value directly as the tensor/base name.|
|**CUDA source parsing robustness** <br> `tilelang/jit/adapter/wrapper.py`|`TLCUDASourceWrapper.parse_source_information` first searches for `T.call_packed("{function_name}"` and, on failure, falls back to `value="{function_name}"`; the matched index is used for sorting function names.|
|**Tests - API/inspection changes** <br> `testing/python/language/test_tilelang_language_let.py`, `testing/python/transform/test_tilelang_transform_thread_sync.py`|Updated tests to use `@tilelang.jit` kernel source inspection (`.get_kernel_source()`) and to inspect `mod.script()` instead of `str(mod)` when asserting transformed IR contents.|
